item.title: IonQ Raises 2026 Revenue Outlook After Record Quarter Fueled by Commercial Growth, SkyWater Acquisition
item.summary: Insider Brief IonQ raised its full-year revenue guidance after reporting record second-quarter revenue, as the quantum computing company combined accelerating commercial growth with a series of acquisitions aimed at expanding beyond quantum hardware into a broader computing and networking platform.
